SELECT A.TRADE_ID, A.BUSI_TYPE, A.FINPROD_ID, A.BRANCH, A.FINPROD_TYPE, A.TRADE_DATE, A.VDATE, A.MDATE, A.SETTLE_DATE, A.CCY, A.UNIT_CPRICE, A.UNIT_INT, A.UNIT_FPRICE, A.PAR_VALUE, A.CPRICE_AMT, A.SHARE_AMT, A.PRIN_AMT, A.INT_AMT, A.FPRICE_AMT, A.FEE_AMT, A.FEE_AMT_PAY, A.TRADE_AMT, A.PS, A.YIELD, A.EXER_YIELD, B.INV_AIM, A.TRADE_STATUS, A.P_TRADE_ID, A.IS_CLEAN, A.CPRICE_DATE, D.BOOKSET_ID as prodId, A.CHL_ID, A.COUNTER_ID, A.is_out_trade, A.TRADE_MARKET, A.TRADER, A.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, H.MY_ACCT_NO, F.CUSTOMER_TYPE, P.ACCT_TYPE, B2.BOK_DETAIL_ID, D.TASK_ID, D.BOOKSET_ID, D.BOOKSET_DATE, D.HAPPEN_DATE, D.BOOK_DATE, M.STANDARD_CCY, M.ACCT_STANDARD, N.FEE_TYPE, N.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE, N.FEE_AMT FEE_AMT_DETAIL, N.FEE_ID,
C.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, M.BOK_SPEC_MODE,
A.REGIST_ORG, Q.INV_AIM RECLS_INV_AIM, A.TRADE_MARKET_MODE, A.pay_date, C.MP_FINPROD_ID, C.MP_BRANCH, N.IS_PREPAID, A.ACCR_NUM, A.PS_PAYMENT psPayment ,NULL lossStage ,A.TOTLE_TRADE_ID totleTradeId FROM BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO D INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET M ON D.BOOKSET_ID = M.BOOKSET_ID INNER JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING B ON (D.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID AND D.HAPPEN_DATE = B.HAPPEN_DATE AND D.BOOK_DATE >= B.BOOK_DATE and busi_table ='02' ) INNER JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING_DETAIL B2 ON (B2.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID AND B2.BUSI_TYPE = #{target,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND B2.BUSI_NO = B.BUSI_NO and B2.busi_table =B.busi_table AND B2.BOK_DETAIL_ID = ifnull(D.BOK_DETAIL_ID , B2.BOK_DETAIL_ID) ) INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL A ON (B.BUSI_NO = A.TRADE_ID AND B2.BUSI_TYPE = A.BUSI_TYPE AND A.TRADE_STATUS != #{tradeStsCX,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL A1 ON (A.TRADE_ID = A1.P_TRADE_ID AND A1.TRADE_STATUS = #{tradeStsCX,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD C ON A.TRADE_ID = C.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO F ON (A.COUNTER_ID = F.CUSTOMER_ID ) LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS H ON A.TRADE_ID = H.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS_EXT K ON H.ORDER_ID = K.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL N ON N.TRADE_ID = A.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_CAPACCT_INFO P ON D.BOOKSET_ID = P.BOOKSET_ID AND H.MY_ACCT_NO = P.ACCT_NO AND A.CCY = P.CCY LEFT JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_BARTER Q ON A.TRADE_ID = Q.TRADE_ID AND A.FINPROD_ID = Q.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_TYPE = Q.FINPROD_TYPE WHERE (K.IS_TRADE = #{isTradeY,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR K.IS_TRADE IS NULL) AND A1.TRADE_ID IS NULL AND D.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND D.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} AND D.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} AND D.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} AND D.IS_SUB_BOOKSET = #{IS_SUB_BOOKSET} AND D.TASK_ID = #{taskId}
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT S.TRADE_ID FROM STL_ORDERS S WHERE S.SETTLE_STATUS='02' AND S.TRADE_ID=A.TRADE_ID) ORDER BY D.BOOKSET_ID, B2.BOK_DETAIL_ID
